**Description**

**Why? (Purpose of new scripts)**

- [ ]  Feature
- [ ]  Enhancement
- [ ]  Bug Resolve
- [ ]  Clean code practices.

**Test Deliverables**
- [ ]  Test Set 
- [ ]  Test Executions
- [ ]  Extent Report 

**Attach extent Report**

**Checklist**

- [ ]  PR title should include task details.
- [ ]  Mentions any dependencies required for this test script to run successfully.
- [ ]  Write proper assertions message.
- [ ]  Page Class name should end with Page and Test Class name should end with Test.
- [ ]  Every script must be independent. Use common functions package’s functions.
- [ ]  Verify all Response Code for each Endpoint : 200,401,422,404
- [ ]  Verify Response payload.
- [ ]  Use data providers to reduce code duplications.
- [ ]  Avoid code duplicacy.
- [ ]  For Test suite stability, Run scripts at least 10 times with main Test Suites. It should be always 100%.
- [ ]  Create a separate test suite (XML file) for new service if required. 
- [ ]  Add schema Validation for each endpoint. (IMP)
     - [ ]   With or without any values for each field.
- [ ]  Code formatting : for macOS (cmd + Shift +F)
- [ ]  Attach ExtentReport for new scripts and Mail Test suite.
- [ ]  Give priority to Quality scripts over Quantity.
- [ ]  Naming conventions: It should be understandable and maintainable.
- [ ]  Use a Risk-based test strategy for each test coverage/scenario.
